ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1.5:1 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large contiguous high-intensity white blobs occupy the interior of the left and right lobes. These are bisected by a central low-intensity black zone extending from the peduncle. A continuous low-intensity black band (width approx. 10-40 pixels) maps the entire trailing edge and lobe tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees; depth is roughly 15% of the visible vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary. Pixel-amplitude of peaks varies from 5 to 30 pixels, with the highest density of serration occurring at the distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex outer curvature on both lobes, sweeping posteriorly to acute, tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast low-intensity pixels located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Sparse, small (5-10 pixel diameter) circular dark spots are distributed across the high-intensity white lobe regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent, high-contrast vertical linear disruption is located on the right lobe. Several lower-contrast diagonal and horizontal linear markings are visible on the interior region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant vertical linear scar on the right lobe surface; irregular, deeply notched trailing edge topography consistent with acquired trauma; clusters of anomalies at both lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: The boundary between the central low-intensity peduncle region and the high-intensity lobes features a feathered, non-linear pixel intensity gradient.
